name: B.C. Power Controls Limited
summary: B.C. Power Controls Limited manufactures and sells wires and cables in India. The company offers insulated cables and copper wires/rods, as well as copper scraps. It also provides armored cables, unarmored cables, flexible and house wires, submersible cables, and control and instrumentation cables. In addition, the company trades in ferrous and non-ferrous metals, including copper. It also exports its products. B.C. Power Controls Limited was founded in 2008 and is based in New Delhi, India.
